dedupe_keys.name: fhwa truck platooning early deployment assessment phase 2 deployment plan and field test on i 10 and i 20 california path

description: This Caltrans final report (CA23-3639), prepared by the California PATH program at UC Berkeley, documents the deployment plan of the FHWA Truck Platooning Early Deployment Assessment Phase 2. It covers the technical approach for cooperative adaptive cruise control (CACC), including system functions and initial functional safety considerations; the test design, with progressive CACC performance tests in public traffic, a professional driver acceptance test with Roly's Trucking at Rancho Cucamonga and an operational readiness test on the route along Interstates 10 and 20; a data management plan for on-truck data collection, real-time monitoring, uploads to the UC Berkeley data server, health checks and sharing with FHWA and the independent evaluator; a human use plan with IRB approval, driver recruitment, training and questionnaires; and a partnership plan, since the route crosses California, Arizona, New Mexico and Texas. The report is dated 15 November 2022 and covers work from June 2021 to February 2023. Access: public PDF, 60 pages in the documentation page. Licence and cost: free, no distribution restrictions. Caveats: a plan and test design, not the evaluation results of the field test. It informs operations and capacity studies of automated freight corridors and digital twin testbeds. It relates to the Freight Analysis Framework and the SUMO traffic simulator in the catalogue.
